title: Foster & Kinship Carer Trauma-Informed Support (Carer Track)
description: Carer Track & SS-AST-010: Equips foster, kinship, and family carers to support placement stability, respond to trauma and loyalty conflicts, facilitate safe family contact, and record objective observations separated from interpretation.
outcomes: Provide trauma-informed, culturally safe care that honours the child's identity, family connections, and felt safety
Prepare and support children before and after family contact visits without loyalty pressure
Record factual, objective carer observations that clearly separate direct observation and the child's own words from adult interpretation
